saw_lines: Buyers of electric brushes compare the routine first, then reorder heads and tips on a schedule they barely think about.
So the sale is won in line one, before the buyer scrolls past, and your ads give no reason to stop.
Your site explains free shipping from 49,90 €, yet 0 of your 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so buyers hesitate. Lead the next batch with free shipping in line one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site explains free shipping from 49,90 €, yet 0 of your 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. Buyers hesitate on arrival before they tap. Lead the next batch with free shipping in line one, then repeat it in each headline.
The same copy runs in 7 of your 23 copy ads, so a buyer who saw one skips the next. Keep the body, but change the opening line and creative in each of the 7 so each reads as new.
0 of your 23 copy ads carry a proof number. Buyers trust a count before a claim, so the ad gives them nothing to check. Collect one real figure, like review count or orders shipped, and lead with it.

7 of your 23 copy ads open on one question, “du hasst zahnseide? du bist...” so a buyer who never flosses gets one entry point. Test two new openers against it: the 60 second clean and the 2 minute whitening.

ads_1: Free shipping leads each creative, with two new openers tested against the Zahnseide hook
